class.name: CbItemBody
class.brief_description: The body an item has when it lies in the world, authored in the item's scene.
class.description: A [BoxShape3D] or a [SphereShape3D], placed where the shape's centre is from the grip (the scene's origin), unrotated. Baking writes it to [code]items/<kind>.cfg[/code] ([code]bake_items.gd[/code]; publishing a mod runs it), which the server reads from the mod's item. In the game the node does nothing: the simulation owns the physics.

method.name: bake
method.description: The baked text: [code]{ text, error }[/code] ([code]text[/code] is empty when the shape cannot be baked).
